source_caption_text:
AB Couldn’t Process What Just Happened.. 😭😳

Adrien Broner, also known as “AB” and “The Problem,” is an American boxer and internet personality from Cincinnati, Ohio. Broner became one of boxing’s biggest personalities during the 2010s, winning major world championships across four different weight divisions—super featherweight, lightweight, super lightweight and welterweight. His career included fights against major names such as Manny Pacquiao, Mikey Garcia, Marcos Maidana, Shawn Porter, Paulie Malignaggi and Jessie Vargas. 

Outside of traditional boxing, Broner has built a strong presence as a streamer and online entertainer, bringing the same outspoken and unpredictable personality that made him famous in boxing into livestream content. That crossover has introduced “AB” to a newer generation that may know him just as much from viral clips and streams as from his championship boxing career. At his peak in the ring, Broner was considered one of boxing’s biggest personalities, becoming a four-division champion by age 26. 

Broner’s move into the streaming world has also given fans a different look at him outside the ring. Instead of only seeing him during fight promotions and interviews, viewers get to see his everyday personality through live conversations, reactions, collaborations and viral moments. His combination of professional boxing credentials and an entertaining personality makes him stand out in the growing boxer-streamer space, as he continues building his presence online while remaining closely associated with the sport that originally made him famous.
